readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)
assay_method: Polymerase kinetic profiling (PKPro). 20 nM polymerase, 1 uM 30-mer DNA template, 100 uM each NTP, 1x ThermoPol buffer, 2x LC Green Plus; denature 95 degC 3 min, extend 55 degC 30 min, fluorescence every 6 s; rate from a linear fit of nucleotides per polymerase vs time; mean of three independent replicates.
remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent, which is 1.0 by definition. The reference sequence is the engineered Tgo-D4K parent, not native Tgo. Position 659 follows the source data, which carries Y and lists the variant as Y659E; the paper text instead calls it H659E. Q93A is listed twice with values differing by 7e-5, and the mean is used.

readout: Fitness of the double mutant under band-pass ampicillin selection, on a scale where wild type reads about 1; higher is more active
assay_method: Pairs of mutations at consecutive codons of TEM-1, assayed in Escherichia coli with the same band-pass MIC-like selection the authors used for their single-substitution map: cells grow only when beta-lactamase activity falls inside a window, since too little fails the ampicillin challenge while too much prevents the cell-wall damage that induces TetC. Counts were taken across eleven ampicillin concentrations from 0.25 to 256 ug/mL. Values are from supplementary sheet S2, column 'Double Mutant Fitness'.
remark: Every genotype here is a double mutant at two consecutive positions, joined with ':', so this file is entirely pairwise epistasis -- the quantity the benchmark has least of. The sequence is UniProt P62593 exactly, 286 aa, and all 12,374 wild-type pairs in the sheet verify against it at both positions. Positions are sequential over the preprotein; the sheet also carries an Ambler column and it gives the offset as + 2 over sequential 1-236, + 3 for 237-249 and + 4 for 250-286, which is what the 2014, 2015 and 2016 branches independently establish. There is no wild-type row in this sheet, so wt_readout is empty and the zero point of normalized-score is the dataset mean; the scale is the same band-pass fitness as Firnberg 2014-DMS-TEM1 on the 2014 branch, whose measured wild type reads 1.0299, so wild type is about 1 here but is not exactly 1 by definition and is not asserted as such. Not extracted: the sheet's Epistasis column, which is a derived difference between the double mutant and the additive expectation of its two singles and has no higher-is-better orientation, so it cannot be oriented as a FitnessBench readout; its Positive and Negative Sign Epistasis flags for the same reason; and the Mut 1 and Mut 2 Fitness columns, which are the single-substitution values from the earlier study already shipped on the 2014 branch. Sheet S1 holds the raw sequencing counts behind these values across eleven ampicillin concentrations and S3 the wild-type counts; neither is a per-variant phenotype.
